meta.scoring: Full PPR, 4pt pass TD, -2 INT, 40+ yd bonuses, return yds 20/pt, boosted DST tiers

players.name: Christian McCaffrey
players.note: Age 30 off 413 touches (450 w/ playoffs). Only 1 RB in 13 yrs has gone top-5 after a 400-touch season; zero top-5s among 27+ backs who led the league in touches. PFF's 2nd-lowest-graded rusher, career-low 3.8 YPC. Preseason tightness; opens in Australia.

players.name: Ashton Jeanty
players.note: Monitoring case, no official Week 1 designation yet. Yates' breakout pick — a 1st-rd fantasy pick last yr who was solid but unspectacular. Note he was among the four RBs with the least room before contact.

players.name: Kenneth Walker
players.note: Best situation of his career. KC was 8th in rushing success rate with the 3rd-lowest stuff rate. 2nd in explosive run rate, 1st in missed tackles forced per attempt. Now the favorite for goal-line work he never had in SEA. 3rd-easiest early schedule.

players.name: Zay Flowers
players.note: Monitoring case with no official Week 1 game designation.

players.name: Malik Nabers
players.note: Tore his ACL and damaged the meniscus last September, needed a second surgery this offseason, and remains uncertain for Week 1. Elite when right — this is purely an availability bet.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Expanded role in PHI. Has averaged at least 3.5 rec and 50 yds per game every year of his career and finished top-30 in PPG in each of the last four despite being the clear No.2 behind A.J. Brown — who is now in New England.

players.name: Trey McBride
players.note: 169 targets and 11 TDs both scream regression — TD total was 2x his career high. ARI led NFL in attempts but used the No.3 pick on Jeremiyah Love and wants MHJ involved. Could throw 100 fewer times; Carson Beck audition looms.

players.name: Breece Hall
players.note: Draft Sharks makes the case he smashes his ADP.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.note: Fitzmaurice takes him anywhere in the back half of Rd 2. 112-1194-5 on 153 targets as a rookie; last yr was a Wk1 PCL/bone bruise. Scored 7 TDs in 8 games once healthy. Anemic LV WR room + TE-friendly Cousins + Kubiak. McBride-2025 comp.

players.name: Emeka Egbuka
players.note: Sprained toe that may affect Week 1 availability. Also worth knowing: he opened last yr at 5.0-89-1.0 per game over five games, then fell to 3.2-41-0.1 over his final 12 with 5.5 yds/target.

players.name: Jaylen Waddle
players.note: Moves from an offense 29th in neutral pass rate to one that was 4th, and 4th in total attempts. 12th in targets per route, 12th in YPRR, 7th in first downs per route, 12th in separation score. Beat Sutton in every category but route win rate.

players.name: Bucky Irving
players.note: The whole industry is fading him. From Wk10 of his rookie yr through the playoff loss he averaged 111.6 scrimmage yds/gm over 9 games. 3.93 YAC/att led all RBs with 60+ carries in '24. Still averaged 20.3 touches even with Tucker on the goal line and White on 3rd down.

players.name: Quinshon Judkins
players.note: RB26 in PPG Wks 2-15 despite 18.7 touches — volume-driven and TD-dependent. 40th of 49 in explosive run rate, 2nd-to-last in rushing success rate. Returning from dislocated ankle + fractured fibula; rebuilt OL that's never played together.

players.name: Luther Burden III
players.note: Draft Sharks' pick as the highest-upside player in 2026 drafts — their 'who's this year's JSN' answer.

players.name: Rome Odunze
players.note: Draft Sharks flags him as a potential 2026 steal.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: 33, has missed 12 games over two seasons, fought a recurring quad issue all summer and is currently sidelined with a groin injury.

players.name: Christian Watson
players.note: New contract, clear WR1 with Doubs and Wicks gone. Wks 8-18 he was WR21 in PPG on just an 18.2% target share and a 68% route share (56th of 109). 4th in YPRR, 6th in fantasy pts per route among 109 qualifiers. More routes = more everything.

players.name: Parker Washington
players.note: Wks 16-19 he was JAX's clear WR1: 22.3 PPR/gm, 113.5 yds/gm, 28.9% target share, 3.78 YPRR, 33.3% first-read share. Lawrence has always preferred him and Meyers over BTJ. 85.1 PFF receiving grade.

players.name: DK Metcalf
players.note: Finished outside weekly top-36 in 7 of 15 games. 25th in YPRR, 26th in RZ targets, 37th in first downs per route. Ranks 41st vs two-high coverage (19th vs single-high) in a league where 16 teams play two-high on 50%+ of snaps.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.note: HARD AVOID. Placed on the Commissioner's Exempt List Aug 30 — cannot practice or play while on it. Charged with two misdemeanors from a May arrest; first court date Nov 17. GM says he anticipates Jacobs playing at some point in 2026, which is not a timeline. His 30.6 ADP std dev is the highest on the board because half the market hasn't updated.

players.name: Jadarian Price
players.note: ESPN flags him as a terrific bargain going roughly five rounds later than the comparable back. Note the 11.1 ADP std dev and 3,146 times drafted — the market is actively arguing about him right now.

players.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
players.note: WR43 overall, WR47 in PPG. Averaged 6-9.5-76.2 with Mac Jones in '24; 3.6-6.1-58.4 across 21 games with Lawrence. Ranked 4th in the hierarchy behind Washington, Meyers and Strange in 5 games together. Brutal early CB slate.

players.name: Rico Dowdle
players.note: Priced within a half-round of Warren but profiles as the lesser fit. Steelers RBs drew 25.4% of targets (2nd-highest). Warren 2.6 rec/gm + 72.0 pass-block grade vs Dowdle 1.4 rec/gm + 24.6. Rodgers at 42 needs a protector/outlet.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.note: PFF's early-round QB target.

players.name: Seattle Defense
players.note: DST1. Top scoring defense in football last yr and best in 3rd-down conversion rate; 6th-ranked unit in 2024. All starters returning.

players.name: Chuba Hubbard
players.note: RB40 in PPG last yr, lost job to Dowdle. Last of 49 qualifiers in both missed-tackle rate and explosive run rate. Zero runs of 15+ yards on 140+ carries — no other RB in PFF's 15-yr dataset has done that. Brooks competing; hamstring.

players.name: J.K. Dobbins
players.note: Multi-week climb as Denver's early-down hammer. A fine RB2/flex whenever he's on the field — availability has always been the question, not the role.

players.name: Denver Defense
players.note: DST2. Best pressure rate in the league (30.5%), 2nd in 3rd-down rate, 3rd in points allowed. Entire starting defense returning.

players.name: Kenny Gainwell
players.note: The committee argument against Irving leans on him, but Irving has averaged 1.56 career YPRR to Gainwell's 1.19 and out-caught him in college against better competition.

players.name: Jayden Reed
players.note: Up ~7 spots returning to health from a broken collarbone and Jones-fracture surgery that cost him most of 2025. Doubs and Wicks are both gone — those vacated targets go to Reed, Watson and Golden.

players.name: George Kittle
players.note: 32 and coming off a torn Achilles; still a monitoring case with no official Week 1 designation.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.note: Two ACL tears in the same knee within 13 months is real reason for pause, but Loza likes the sleeper appeal at this cost. CAR has been vocal about letting him compete; Canales says the backs could split if Hubbard is healthy. This regime spent pick 46 on him.

players.name: Trevor Lawrence
players.note: From Wk5 on he outscored every player at every position at 23 pts/gm; ~28 with a full WR room. Top-5 in PPG, 1st in expected fantasy pts/gm. 4th-most RZ pass attempts, 3rd-most RZ carries, 9 rush TDs (only Allen had more). Yr 2 with Coen.

players.name: Houston Defense
players.note: DST3. Best 1st-down defense, 2nd in points per game, top-10 in 3rd-down rate and sacks. Added Blankenship and E.J. Speed.

players.name: Tucker Kraft
players.note: His 9.3 yds/target led all TEs by a full 1.5 yards over the next-closest player. The only thing missing was volume. Even with an efficiency dip, more work is a clean trade. Realistic path to top-3 TE if the recovery holds.

players.name: LA Rams Defense
players.note: Acquired Myles Garrett. 9th in points allowed, solid pressure rate. Added McDuffie and Watson.

players.name: Xavier Worthy
players.note: PFF late-round option with a path to increased production.

players.name: Aaron Jones Sr.
players.note: Posted career lows in YPC, RYOE/att, YAC/att, missed tackles forced and PFF grade — all five — at 31. Looks out of gas.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Clear No.2 behind A.J. Brown for Maye. Goes from GB (30th in neutral pass rate) to NE (9th, and likely higher with Brown, Doubs and a 2nd yr of Maye). Landing-spot riser the market is still catching up to.

players.name: Sam LaPorta
players.note: Draft Sharks calls him solid value in the TE tier.

players.name: Jordan Mason
players.note: Beat Aaron Jones in all five key efficiency metrics: 4.8 vs 4.2 YPC, +1.02 vs -0.12 RYOE/att, 2.42 vs 1.67 YAC/att, 83.8 vs 69.5 PFF. Jones posted career lows in all five at 31. New OL coach brings outside zone — Mason averages 5.6 YPC on it.

players.name: Minnesota Defense
players.note: Top-3 in pressure rate, top-5 in 3rd-down defense, top-10 in points allowed. Better offense should help.

players.name: KC Concepcion
players.note: Up 15 spots on the week. Real path to being CLE's clear No.1. Top-35 in FBS in YAC per reception in two of his last three college seasons. The downside (QB play, Boston and Fannin competing) is fully priced in; the upside isn't.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.note: Flashed as a rookie: 63.7% completions, 15 TD to 5 INT behind a shaky supporting cast.

players.name: Blake Corum
players.note: Textbook miss-small-hit-big. Worst case he backs up Kyren in a great offense at an RB34 price. If Kyren misses time he's the lead back for a championship favorite with run-friendly scripts — a top-10 weekly RB.

players.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
players.note: Biggest riser on the board, up ~27 spots in a week on Ricky Pearsall's season-ending PCL injury. 4.36 forty, 95th-pct RAS. 6-67 on 22 snaps in the preseason opener, then 4-of-5 for 46. Everyone ahead of him is 30+ or hurt: Evans (33, groin), Kittle (32, Achilles), CMC (30), Deebo (30).

players.name: Rashid Shaheed
players.note: His Seattle stat line is a mid-season-trade artifact — that group of 10 traded WRs saw production fall 16.3%. SEA then gave him 3yr/$51M, which no other WR on that list got. 12th in career yards per catch, 13th in yards per target among 102 active WRs with 100+ catches. Kupp is 33 and coming off career lows.

players.name: New England Defense
players.note: Benefited from an easy schedule but returned to form. Added Dre'Mont Jones and Byard, drafted Jacas in Rd 2.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.note: PFF late-round RB with upside at his cost.

players.name: Philadelphia Defense
players.note: Below league average in pressure rate and 3rd down but 5th in points allowed with good turnover volume.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.note: Best QB value on the board. Named MIN starter and his ADP never moved — still Rd 12. Never finished worse than QB12 in PPG before last yr's 5-game season; 7th among active QBs in career PPG. O'Connell's offenses ranked 3rd/5th/5th in QB passing points. 36.7 career rush yds/gm.

players.name: Keenan Allen
players.note: Officially a Colt and the ADP responded. Partly a signal on Alec Pierce's health, mostly a reflection of how thin IND is behind Pierce and Downs. Was WR36 in PPG last yr and still one of the better route-winners and slot producers in the league.

players.name: Isaiah Likely
players.note: In 9 career games without Andrews: 3.4 rec, 50.3 yds, 0.7 TD per game — a full-season pace of 58-856-11 that would have been TE2 in total PPR points. Top-8 in yards per catch and per target among 53 TEs with 100+ targets. 3yr/$40M, 5th-highest-paid TE. Reportedly Dart's favorite target.

players.name: Tyler Shough
players.note: QB12 in PPG across 9 rookie starts. 11th in completion rate, 13th in YPA, 17th in PFF passing grade among 42 QBs with 150+ attempts. 174 rush yds ranked 12th; 61 on designed runs was 4th. Kellen Moore offenses: top-4 pace in 6 of 7 seasons.

players.name: Zach Charbonnet
players.note: Confirmed unavailable for the opening four games (reserve list). This is a transaction, not a guess.

players.name: Jalen McMillan
players.note: Mike Evans left ~130 targets/1,153 yds behind. McMillan scored 8 TDs as a rookie; over his last 6 games that yr he had a 19.3% target share, 26-357-7 and ranked 18th in PPG. Egbuka has a sprained toe and cratered late last season; Godwin is 30 off career lows.

players.name: Jordan Love
players.note: PFF later-round QB with upside.

players.name: LA Chargers Defense
players.note: Consistent across every key category; high-scoring offense forces opponents to chase. New DC, drafted Mesidor in Rd 1.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.note: Real-life success, fantasy avoid. SEA finished 25th in neutral pass rate and dead last in pass rate when trailing. QB22 in PPG with only seven weekly QB1 finishes. Nothing in the 2026 setup changes it.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.note: Led ALL TEs at 2.79 YPRR — best mark by a TE with 40+ targets since Kittle in 2020. Also led in targets per route (0.27) and fantasy pts per route (0.70). Finished TE19 only because he ran a route on 44.2% of pass plays (40th). Beane publicly said the goal is more snaps. Healthy all summer.

players.name: Emmett Johnson
players.note: Won the KC No.2 job outright — started the preseason finale, then Demercado was released. 26-123-1 on 4.7 YPC across three exhibitions; 4th in missed tackles forced per attempt and 6th in PFF Elusive Rating among 103 RBs with 10+ carries. Handcuffs a Walker who's missed 10 games in 4 years.

players.name: Najee Harris
players.note: PFF late-round RB value; the NYG signing is what pushed Tracy down.

players.name: Malik Washington
players.note: PFF late-round WR with a path to a bigger role.

players.name: Jacksonville Defense
players.note: Solid fantasy season but shaky 3rd-down defense, poor pressure rate, few sacks — was turnover-reliant. Samulski suspects he's too high on them.

players.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
players.note: PFF late-round RB with upside.

players.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
players.note: Down ~13 spots. Najee Harris signing plus a blown pass-pro assignment in the preseason opener muddied the split. Backfield division genuinely up in the air — avoid until it clears.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.note: Steepest fall of the week, down ~34 spots. Hamstring now expected to linger into the regular season, possibly as far as Week 7. The eventual No.2 in NO once healthy, but 2026 availability is the entire question. WR4/WR5 dart only.

players.name: Keaton Mitchell
players.note: PFF late-round RB with upside.

players.name: Dylan Sampson
players.note: Capable back who could become CLE's preferred pass-catcher. FantasyPros calls him a more appealing bet than Judkins roughly 100 picks later.

players.name: Cooper Kupp
players.note: Turned 33 in June, coming off career lows in receiving yds/gm (37.1), YPRR (1.40) and PFF grade (70.8). Finished 52nd among qualifying WRs in yards per route. Shaheed is coming for the No.2 job.

players.name: Malik Willis
players.note: PFF later-round QB with upside.

players.name: Adonai Mitchell
players.note: Elite target earner: 27% target-per-route as a rookie (18th of 128), 26% last yr (14th of 126). After the NYJ trade he ran a route on 80.4% of pass plays Wks 12-17 with 8.2 targets/gm and a 24.9% share — WR31 in PPG, and that was with Tyrod/Brady Cook throwing on a 13.8-ppg offense. Geno now.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.note: LAR TEs scored the 2nd-most PPR points last yr, split four ways. Breer reports a fantastic offseason and the Rams think he can be one of the league's best. 18.3 aDOT led all TEs, 21.0 yds/rec, scored on 3 of 11 catches. McVay called him a total stud. Nothing behind Nacua and Adams.

players.name: Baltimore Defense
players.note: Added Trey Hendrickson and Calais Campbell; Anthony Weaver back as DC.

players.name: Kenyon Sadiq
players.note: ESPN's rookie-TE swing. Slated for a hybrid WR/TE role. The Bowers-comp argument: low-scoring offense, no elite QB — same things said about Bowers coming in. Low-cost, late-round.

players.name: Brenton Strange
players.note: PFF late-round TE value. Held a 14% target share at 4.4 targets/gm in JAX and out-targeted BTJ in games with Washington and Meyers healthy.

players.name: Greg Dulcich
players.note: New MIA GM named him unprompted as the player he's most excited about. 2nd among TEs in YPRR from Wk9 on and 2nd in YAC/rec behind only Kraft. His 2.7 YPRR is the 4th-best TE mark since 2022. Barren Miami depth chart.

players.name: Chris Bell
players.note: Flagged as an emerging sleeper in Rotoworld's ADP movers.

players.name: Ryan Flournoy
players.note: The rare WR handcuff worth a bench spot. 6-114 with Lamb out in Wk5; 9-115-1 on 13 targets when Lamb left early in Wk14. Schottenheimer says Dak doesn't hesitate throwing to him. DAL sits 1st by a comfortable margin in Draft Sharks' Environment Scores.

players.name: Tank Dell
players.note: On injured reserve with a return designation.

players.name: Travis Hunter
players.note: Adds uncertainty to the JAX hierarchy alongside BTJ and Washington. Also expected to be more impactful on defense this year.

players.name: Malik Davis
players.note: Flagged as an emerging sleeper in Rotoworld's ADP movers.

players.name: Germie Bernard
players.note: Listed behind Pittman on the initial PIT depth chart.

players.name: Chig Okonkwo
players.note: PFF late-round TE value. Posted a 2.62 YPRR season in 2022 — one of only five 2.5+ TE seasons since 2020.
